title: Patellar Dislocation Event
note: Generated by tools/positions.py --extract from the page itself. Edit the verification, kind, signed_off_by and note fields; everything else is rewritten on the next extraction. The detector over collects on purpose: mark anything that is teaching rather than clinical direction as NOT_CLINICAL rather than deleting it.

positions.as_written: Ask whether the kneecap came out of place, and whether they or anybody else saw it to the side.
Ask how it went back: spontaneously on straightening the leg, by the patient pushing it, or by somebody else.
Ask whether it has happened before, and whether the other knee has ever done it.
Ask about immediate swelling, which is usual after a first dislocation.
Ask about family history and about general flexibility, since both bear on why it happened.
